roles.name: Quality Auditor
roles.description: Performs deep structural quality audits using the derived audit-technique rotation — steer-mode audit-technique skills whose programmaticHome is unset, queried live from team.json rather than listed statically. Lenses drop out of the rotation automatically once the skill-optimizer records that their detection has graduated into a programmatic engine. Creates execute backlog items with evidence and draft plan notes when findings are material; does not promote lenses, re-tag skills, or edit target scenario code.

roles.name: Bug Investigator
roles.description: Drains bug-inbox/* (universal-source intake — any team's members may file via the report-bug skill), applies a registered investigation technique from docs/scenario-qa/methods/investigation/, and closes each entry with a bug-investigation-report/<slug> audit-log entry naming the technique applied and outcome taken.

roles.name: QA Contrarian
roles.description: Cross-cutting skeptic for scenario-qa. Reads peer-member outputs (bug-investigation-reports, audits, readiness backlog) and writes challenge-report/* entries citing specific failure modes from the technique registries. Does not generate positive-action proposals.
